header.title: Magnetic
header.description: A subtle pull that moves the content toward the pointer. `trigger` sets when it follows the pointer, `strength` and `maxOffset` how far it moves (when omitted, `intensity` sets them) and `radius` widens the pull area. With `prefers-reduced-motion: reduce` the content stays still.

playground.title: Playground
playground.description: Combine the props and see the generated code. `strength` and `maxOffset` set to `auto` let `intensity` define them.

tile.title: On a block
tile.description: With the default `trigger` (`hover`), the surface moves toward the pointer and settles back on leave. The box that receives the pointer stays put, so the content keeps responding.

image.title: On an image
image.description: It works with any child, including a native `img`. Here with `intensity="sm"` for a more contained motion on a large element.

triggers.title: Hover and press
triggers.description: With `hover` it follows the pointer while it's over the box. With `press` only while held (it captures the pointer, so you can drag outside the box).

proximity.title: Proximity
proximity.description: With `trigger="proximity"` the pull starts when the pointer is within `radius` pixels of the box, without touching it. It uses a `window` listener.

radius.title: Pull area
radius.description: With `hover` or `press`, `radius` widens the area that detects the pointer without shifting layout: the pull starts before reaching the visible edge.

intensity.title: Intensity
intensity.description: When `strength` and `maxOffset` are omitted, `intensity` sets them: `sm` 0.2 and 10 px, `md` 0.35 and 16 px, `lg` 0.5 and 28 px. It takes a token or a number between `0` and `1`.

pull.title: Strength and cap
pull.description: `strength` is the fraction of the distance to the center the surface follows (between `0` and `1`) and `maxOffset` the peak offset in pixels. High strength with a small cap feels firm but contained.

axis.title: Axes
axis.description: `axis` limits the motion: `both` (default), horizontal only (`x`) or vertical only (`y`).

asChild.title: asChild
asChild.description: With `asChild`, the effect is applied to the child without adding a `div`. Here, on a gem-system `Button` with `radius={24}`. It follows the pointer with the same quick transition as the default `div`.

state.title: Paused and disabled
state.description: `isPaused` freezes the current offset: move it, turn on pause and the surface stays where it was. `isDisabled` returns it to rest and keeps the content interactive.

callbacks.title: Events
callbacks.description: `onMagnetic` fires when it starts following the pointer and `outMagnetic` when it settles back, with the cause in `event.reason`. Pressing an inner button freezes the offset so the click lands.

texts.body: Hover over the card and click the button.

hook.title: useMagnetic
hook.description: Headless version. The hook returns `ref`, `style` (with `--gemfx-magnetic-x` and `-y`), `pointerProps` and `pose`; you build the markup. Useful to read the offset or apply it to your own element.

header.title: Magnetic API
header.description: Reference for the props, the `useMagnetic` hook, inheritance, accessibility, CSS classes and variables, and exported types of `Magnetic`.

demos.title: Demos
demos.description: Playground and examples of each trigger and option.

import.title: Import
import.description: Import it from `@gem-org/gemffects/magnetic` with its `magnetic.css`, or from the root if you already load `styles.css`.

hook.description: Takes the same options as `Magnetic` except `children`, `asChild`, `className`, `classNames` and `ref` (`UseMagneticOptions`). You render the host with `.gemfx-magnetic` and the surface with `.gemfx-magnetic__surface`, or apply `transform` directly.

result.ref: Ref for the host. Used to measure the box when computing the offset.
result.style: Inline styles with the `--gemfx-magnetic-*` variables. Already includes the `style` you passed.
result.pointerProps: Pointer handlers for the host. They call the ones you passed in the options first.
result.motionClassName: `gemfx-ignore-reduced-motion` if you passed `ignoreReducedMotion`. Add it to the host.
result.transform: Ready-to-use `translate3d(x, y, 0)` if you don't use `.gemfx-magnetic__surface`.
result.isHover: `trigger` is `hover` and the effect is active.
result.isPress: `trigger` is `press` and the effect is active.
result.isProximity: `trigger` is `proximity` and the effect is active.

inheritance.title: Inheritance
inheritance.body: Accepts the attributes of HTMLAttributes<HTMLElement> and passes them to the root div (or to the child, with asChild). Pointer handlers you pass (onPointerEnter, onPointerMove, onPointerDown, etc.) run before the effect's internal logic.

items.transformOnly: The motion is transform only, on the surface; with the default div, the box that receives the pointer doesn't move, so the child keeps receiving clicks and focus in the same place. With asChild the child itself moves.
items.reducedMotion: With prefers-reduced-motion: reduce the surface stays at rest and doesn't follow the pointer.
items.ignoreReducedMotion: ignoreReducedMotion (or the gemfx-ignore-reduced-motion class on an ancestor) forces the motion. Only use it if it's essential.
items.nested: Pressing an inner interactive element (button, a, input…) freezes the offset until release, so the click lands on the target.
items.pointerOnly: It only responds to the pointer: the keyboard doesn't trigger it. It's decoration; don't communicate anything through the motion alone.
items.touch: It's off on touch screens by default (disabledOnTouch is true), so the offset doesn't get in the way of taps or scrolling. Mouse and pen keep working.
items.proximity: With proximity, radius is the activation distance and doesn't widen the clickable area. It listens to pointermove on window: avoid many instances on the same page.

items.tracking: Added while following the pointer. Shortens the transition to `80ms` so it responds instantly.
items.field: Pseudo-element that widens the pointer area by `--gemfx-magnetic-radius`. With `proximity` it has `pointer-events: none`.
items.surface: Wraps the child and is what moves (`transform`).

cssVariables.title: CSS variables
cssVariables.description: All of them are written inline on the root on every render: use the props to change them. For different behavior, override the `.gemfx-magnetic__surface` transition from a class.

items.duration: Transition back to rest. Set by `duration`; default `280ms`.
items.radius: Extra margin of the pointer area. Set by `radius` (`0px` with `proximity`).

tokens.title: Tokens
tokens.description: Global variables Magnetic reads as defaults.

items.easingEmphasized: Curve for settling back to rest.

content.title: Content
content.description: Which content is pulled and where the effect is mounted.

appearance.title: Appearance
appearance.description: Strength, cap, intensity, axes and pull area.

timing.title: Timing
timing.description: Settle-back transition and delay, in milliseconds.

state.title: Trigger and state
state.description: When it follows the pointer and how it's paused or turned off.

events.title: Events
events.description: `event.reason` can be `hover`, `press`, `inactive`, `disabled` or `unmount`. With `proximity` it's reported as `hover`.

items.children: Content that is pulled toward the pointer.
items.asChild: Applies the effect to the only child, without a wrapping `div`. The child is both root and surface, and the `--tracking` and `--paused` transitions apply the same. It injects no layers, so it also works with void elements (`img`): the element itself becomes the root.
items.strength: Fraction of the distance to the center the surface follows, between `0` and `1`. When omitted, `intensity` sets it: `0.2`, `0.35` or `0.5`.
items.maxOffset: Peak offset in pixels. When omitted, `intensity` sets it: `10`, `16` or `28`.
items.intensity: Sets `strength` and `maxOffset` when they're missing. A token or a number between `0` and `1`.
items.radius: Extra margin in pixels. With `hover`/`press` it widens the pointer area without shifting layout; with `proximity` it's the distance at which the pull starts.
items.duration: Transition back to rest on release or leave. Negative values are treated as `0`.
items.trigger: `hover` while the pointer is over it, `press` while held and `proximity` while within `radius` of the box.
items.isActive: Allows the pull. With `false` it returns to rest and `outMagnetic` gets `inactive`.
items.isDisabled: Returns to rest and disables the pull; the child stays interactive. `outMagnetic` gets `disabled`.
items.disabledOnTouch: Ignores touch pointers; mouse and pen keep working.
items.ignoreReducedMotion: Moves even if the user prefers reduced motion. Only if essential.
items.onMagnetic: Fires when it starts following the pointer.
items.outMagnetic: Fires when it settles back: on pointer leave, on release with `press`, on leaving the field with `proximity`, on disable or on unmount.
items.style: Inline styles for the root. Merged with the `--gemfx-magnetic-*` variables.
items.ref: Ref to the root (the `div`, or the child with `asChild`).
